## Core Technical Competencies & Specializations

### 1. AI-Powered Web Applications & AI-Integrated Systems
- **AI Integrations**: Gemini API (Flash/Pro), OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic Claude, LangChain, function calling, structured JSON output.
- **RAG Pipelines**: Vector databases with PostgreSQL `pgvector`, embedding generation, cosine similarity search, and hybrid semantic retrieval.
- **AI Backend Architecture**: Streaming LLM responses, token budgeting, prompt injection sanitization, and fallback orchestration.

### 2. Full-Stack Web Development & Modern Frontend
- **Frontend Frameworks**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components, SSG/SSR), React 19, TypeScript.
- **Styling & UI**: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lenis smooth scrolling, responsive design, dark mode tokens.
- **Accessibility & SEO**: WCAG AA/AAA contrast compliance, WAI-ARIA semantics, Schema.org JSON-LD, Open Graph, Core Web Vitals optimization.

### 3. Backend Engineering & High-Throughput REST APIs
- **Backend Stack**: Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, RESTful API design, OpenAPI/Swagger 3.0.
- **Databases & Cache**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis caching, schema indexing, aggregation pipelines.
- **Concurrency & Performance**: Sub-20ms P99 latency, rate limiting, connection pooling, idempotent payment webhooks.

### 4. Cross-Platform Mobile Engineering (Flutter & Dart)
- **Mobile Stack**: Flutter, Dart, iOS & Android unified codebases, 60fps rendering, Impeller engine optimization.
- **State Management**: BLoC pattern, Provider, Hive local offline-first storage, background queue synchronization.
- **Integrations**: Stripe mobile sheets, Firebase FCM push notifications, App Store & Google Play deployments.
